notes: Access note: the bare apex domain https://andtradition.com/ was unreachable from this workstation (TCP connect timeout, confirmed independently via curl, curl_cffi with 6 impersonation profiles, WebFetch, native Playwright, and the real Chrome browser via claude-in-chrome - all failed identically at the network layer, while google.com and other sites worked fine from the same machine, so this was a routing issue specific to that hostname, not a general outage: Google's translate.goog proxy DID reach it and returned 200, proving the origin itself is up). Discovered the canonical working host is https://www.andtradition.com/ (same site, www subdomain), which connects directly via plain curl/HTTP with no block of any kind - Tier 1 direct HTTP was therefore used for the actual extraction, not a proxy. robots.txt at www.andtradition.com/robots.txt is fully open ('User-agent: *' / 'Disallow: ' / 'Allow: /'), no Claude-specific disallow, so no policy_opt_out applies (and Tier-3 Chrome was not needed once www worked). Site architecture: a Nuxt.js SPA frontend backed by a headless WordPress REST API at wp.andtradition.com/wp-json (namespace 'trouble' + 'wp/v2' + 'menus/v1'). Because the SPA shell serves no content without JS, I pulled the data straight from the API instead of screen-scraping: (1) wp-json/menus/v1/menus/2 = 'Header Menu Left', the full primary nav with all child items expanded - top-level sections are Products (New Collection, All Products, Furniture, Lighting, Objects, Outdoor, Collections, Classics, EU Ecolabel, Configurators), Designers, Inspiration (Stories, Cases, Our Community, Publications, Catalogues), and Visit (Lille Petra Cafe, Petra Hotel, Showrooms) - no holiday/seasonal entry anywhere in this tree, in English or Danish. (2) wp-json/trouble/taxonomy returned the complete list of 175 post_tag terms used to filter /products (every collection name, material, room type, designer-choice tag, etc.) - manually scanned the full list and by keyword (christmas/xmas/jul/holiday/season/halloween/easter/paaske/valentine/diwali/thanksgiving/new year/nytaar/advent/vinter/winter) - zero matches for any holiday/festival term; the only 'season' hit is unrelated ('New Collection' spring/fall product drops, not a calendar holiday). (3) wp-json/trouble/routes returned all 628 published URLs on the site - keyword-scanned the same list; the only holiday-adjacent hits are /journal/christmas-campaign-2025 and /journal/festive-gift-guide, both under /journal/ (their blog/editorial section, confirmed by URL pattern and by every other journal-listed piece being an article/story/portrait, not a product listing) plus /frontpage-outdoor-season which is an outdoor-furniture seasonal homepage variant (weather season, not a holiday), not a genuine PLP - per the rules these are excluded as blog/editorial/landing content, not product-listing categories. &Tradition is a Copenhagen design-furniture/lighting/objects brand (sofas, chairs, tables, lamps, vases, cushions, rugs) with no candles/ornaments/decor-specific holiday range and no dedicated holiday taxonomy or PLP anywhere in its menu, its 175-term product taxonomy, or its full route/sitemap list. Concluding no_seasonal after checking primary nav (EN + spot-checked no Danish-only holiday slugs since the entire taxonomy and route list were scanned, not just the visible English UI), the full category/tag taxonomy, and the full site route list - no internal search endpoint needed since the taxonomy dump was authoritative and exhaustive.
